verdict.rationale: Docs confirm HumanLayer can open a draft pull request from a session (humanlayer-docs-19) and integrates with GitHub for issue-linked tasks (humanlayer-docs-16), but the evidence describes PR creation as a manual 'ask the session agent' action from the UI, not an automatic trigger fired upon task completion. Missing for 10: explicit configuration option/workflow setting for automatic PR creation on task completion, and any evidence of it happening without a manual prompt.
